assignment_rules: Worker role/capability must satisfy the command's required execution role/capability before claim.
Command target scope must be contained by worker allowed_scopes and must not intersect forbidden_scopes.
active_claim_ids count MUST NOT exceed max_concurrent_claims.
OFFLINE, DRAINING or QUARANTINED workers cannot accept new claims.
Worker registry identity/capability never overrides command scope, governance, expected-head guard or human gates.
human_gate_capability=true means the worker can route/escalate to a human gate, not self-approve it.
